{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ministry of Justice building''' on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was the building where [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] held a meeting with twenty [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. Held on the top floor of the building, Luke called the meeting to discuss the two defectors the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had in custody, the [[Priestess/Legends|Priestess]] [[Elan]] and her [[familiar]] [[Vergere]].
